notes.title: How did the launch go?
notes.content:
Easy Mode is now... Easy?
Today we are releasing the v2.3.21 update for Final Outpost. We heard your feedback that easy mode wasn't a whole lot easier than normal mode, so we're introducing some changes today to make the easy mode experience a little more relaxed.

Buffed the Fragile Zombies (weaker zombies) modifier to reduce zombie health by 33% (from 20%)

Increased the delay between zombie hits to 1.5s (from baseline of 1s) in Easy difficulty

These changes should make a significant difference to the difficulty. Zombies are weaker and damage walls more slowly, easing all other parts of the game thanks to less pressure on wood supplies for workers.


How did the launch go?
So what happened since we launched Final Outpost: Definitive Edition?

Quite a lot.

Firstly, a bunch of you only went and bought our game. 18,000 of you, to be precise. We couldn't be happier! Thank you to each and every player. You have enabled us to continue making games.

And we're already working on what's coming next.



I mean, what even is this?

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/086264ad86037b68f1d4a376dae3d74d2e58146d.png"]

I'll save an in-engine look for another time.



What was I talking about? Oh yes, Final Outpost.

We launched it with 30,000 wishlists! The game showed up on New & Trending on the Steam homepage, and was featured by Apple on the games tab!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/e7a96427c1835d779aec26f3fb36f281b8e66cbb.png"]

FO:DE made it to the top-5 in many countries, including #3 in Japan strategy games. On Steam, the game peaked at 330 concurrent players.

Also, we ​released trading cards on Steam and got Steam Deck verified​!

notes.title: Deep Dive: Modifiers, Music & More
notes.content:
How do modifiers impact gameplay?​
With 38 modifiers and a thousand possible combinations, each Outpost presents unique challenges.

To give you a little taster, here are some examples:

 Barbed Boundaries - your walls constantly damage zombies
 Repopulation Doctrine - citizens contribute to the birth rate at all times
 One Shot, One Kill - snipers do double damage


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/fae775ab600172697106272fa1fdcb57778d3664.png

There are also some negative modifiers we are excited to see you play! For example:

 Long-term Contracts - no unassigning allowed, except for horde nights
 Long Lunchbreak - building construction and upgrades can only take place at night
 Focused Onslaught - on blood moon nights ALL zombies go to either the left wall or the right wall


How do Difficulty Modes work?​
Difficulty modes have always been a popular suggestion since Final Outpost began and we are happy to be finally introducing them with Final Outpost Definitive Edition.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/a5115867954b7a491f8452f40a2a79097aceb7fd.png

Easy and Normal feature a new checkpoint system allowing players to save their progress throughout their survival journey.


 Easy Mode involves a smoother start with the larger deer populations of Busy Forests and Beginning of the End attracting more survivors to your Outpost's gates
 Normal and Classic Mode offer a balanced experience with Classic keeping the original mechanics where losing means starting over completely
 Hardcore Mode ramps up the difficulty with Quieter Forests reducing deer reserves and Tougher Zombies increasing enemy health by 10%


Each difficulty mode has its own set of leaderboards and stamps can be collected as you play through each mode.

Introducing our first OST​
Composer Ben Randall has created a brand new soundtrack for the game, featuring main menu and cutscene music, four in-game ambient tracks and dynamic combat music that reacts to the threat level on your walls.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/5abc23e47d7511e0d218d85ebafb7a0d1fbf341c.png

Alongside a range of new sound effects, the new original soundtrack makes it that much easier to get totally immersed in Final Outpost.

Increased Game Speed Controls
We've also included a new 10x fast-foward option for players who want to speedrun their Outpost. This doesn't come without risk, though! It's all too easy to miss a group of survivors or forget to assign your knife fighters...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/862d52990c5416712279d9253f75261ee738a7f7.png

That's all our Deep Dives! We'll be back on launch day :)

- Sam & the Final Outpost team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3066310/Final_Outpost_Definitive_Edition/

notes.title: Deep Dive: Meta-Progression
notes.content:
Progression has always been a part of Final Outpost but now, for the first time, you can settle more than one Outpost and test your survival skills with collectible gameplay modifiers.

So, how do you reach new Outposts?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/1d9e155662a4369ce0429ae8d539d47e6b343677.png

There is now a rusty motorhome amongst the rubble in your Outpost. The motorhome contains a procedurally generated map, which lets you plan your route and decide where to settle next.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/2e1a6232ec70bf0015fa1a97d93ca99af50e1730.png

Once you've repaired the motorhome with parts obtained from the trader, you can move to a new location!

So what happens next?

This is where modifiers come in.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/fae775ab600172697106272fa1fdcb57778d3664.png

In Final Outpost: Definitive Edition, there are 38 modifiers that change everything from seasons and weather to worker efficiency and zombie horde behaviour.

Each location on the map is associated with a negative modifier, sometimes easier, sometimes incredibly challenging, so route planning is crucial to avoid areas with stamps that you don't like!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/78db4b1d43ce5e3e73fef9a07500346d9a276cb9.png

After selecting your destination, you pick from a selection of positive modifiers to optimise the situation you find yourself in. A great positive stamp can help you to complete an Outpost with even the toughest negative modifier.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/d58b142f91b262b9ce611df28cd17a301d3a2abf.png

With 1000 possible Outpost modifier combinations, this system brings a new level of replayability to the game. Choose whether to survive as long as possible in a single Outpost or to traverse the map to get a higher prestige level.

We've also introduced the Stamp Book, allowing you to collect the stamps you found along your survival journey.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/3b76cf6368a7b61f2fc6d4867c4f1af2a4fc06c5.png

Every time you leave an Outpost the modifier stamps tied to that Outpost will be added to the Stamp Book, a fun way to document your progress and showcase your accomplishments - with an achievement for 100% completion!

Finally, we added 10 new achievements and leaderboards that track this new progress. Leaderboards will be tied to difficulty modes, which we'll cover in our next deep dive.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/2273c3df4d81db11dc5a35d7528d946e9ac06f81.png

The motorhome, map, and stamps bring a whole new level of strategy, competition, and replayability to the game. How many Outposts will you settle?

Our next deep dive will cover the new difficulty modes and OST.

- Sam & the Final Outpost team

notes.title: Deep Dive: Trading System
notes.content:
Survival in Final Outpost: Definitive Edition is not just about gathering supplies, it is about making smart trades.

With the introduction of the trader, there is a new way to secure resources and expand faster. Here's our video on the new feature:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bWr-2jiA7wY

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/cf74db34d3dec0d5062cfdf7272bf909eda2f84a.gif

Need 150 stone for an upgrade? Instead of assigning miners, you can trade for it instantly. Facing a food shortage? The trader might have wheat to save your citizens on the brink of famine.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/805bfe47e733ccfbef6b196fb19590cb0f49be36.png

Do you spend gold now to help your citizens in the short term or hold onto it for future trades? Do you gamble on a big upgrade or slowly stockpile for stability? The trader makes possible entirely new strategies for Outpost growth.

However, trading is not available straight away. You will need to build a Radio Tower to attract traders to your Outpost. After parting with 50 scrap, you'll start attracting traders every few days.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/5bb4367734320b1020129a9c566393430f868634.png

An extra bonus of the Radio Tower is that it acts as a rod to absorb some lightning strikes, protecting other buildings in your Outpost. Level 1 and 2 take 15% and 50% of all strikes, respectively. Your Outpost will be better protected for the rest of the game since the Radio Tower cannot catch fire.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/acd9b1067168aa98c74d9b9d0ba3e23ba96cc9c2.png

The level 2 Radio Tower unlocks a new type of trader who offers more valuable deals as well as rare vehicle parts that can be used to repair the decaying Motorhome inside your Outpost. The Motorhome is the hub for the new meta-progression system in Final Outpost: Definitive Edition, with which you'll be able to drive off into the sunset (or sunrise).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/d4357e57e05da08d0d2d49cbf68690e1281a2084.png

Our next deep dive will cover the new meta-progression system.

- Sam & the Final Outpost team

notes.title: Demo now live!
notes.content:
Dear players,

The demo for Final Outpost: Definitive Edition is out now!

This is the first time that a bunch of new features will be playable so we hope you get stuck in and enjoy it. So let's go through what's new.

What's new in the demo?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/956162b0665b6efdef52ef9bc67e8dee722fbeee.gif

Traders

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/cf74db34d3dec0d5062cfdf7272bf909eda2f84a.gif

Traders stop by your Outpost every 3 days with a range of trade offers. Gold has been added to the same as a currency to enable the exchange of resources.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/978690f2ffb46822a493f3c52279b1c019d55b30.png

One might even save your citizens from the brink of starvation!

Difficulty Modes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/b665b376ba6433b98d6f2ed992481137bf9ae7ae.png

The demo includes the Normal and Classic difficulties, each with their own leaderboards. Classic is slightly more difficult as you cannot rewind to an earlier save when your Outpost is destroyed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/a22f07a774df67ea47e9052db11de476179d9f14.png

Normal mode has a new manually editable save panel which allows you to rewind time and try out new strategies.

Environment + UI Changes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/4b3f61a1a5aea54ad7acebd02d44ab75d27681ce.png

We've improved the forest and rubble images, added dirt and grass tufts around the map, brought the colour palette together, and cleaned up season transitions for a more cohesive visual look.

The UI has also been updated for PC with a new control panel that includes a 7.5x speed toggle.

Controller Support

Here's a preview of our full controller support in an alpha build:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/db27dbb20e1be1b30d7fc3d7a4993ca48672bb02.gif

A New Building...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/513409e954150cb2f1ad00e9821add37e72efe4a.gif

New Scoring System

In the demo you can play until the beginning of the first Winter. But there's a twist: we've added a new scoring system that allows you to compete with your friends to build the best Outpost before time runs out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/c18d5977e73be32f7504001cf4e91ed86fe31961.png

So what are you waiting for? Get the free demo on the Steam store page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3066310

- Sam & the Final Outpost team

notes.title: New Leaderboards and Scoring System
notes.content:
Today we are excited to introduce in-game leaderboards to Final Outpost: Definitive Edition alongside a new scoring system.

This is a great time to talk about the demo for FO:DE. The demo will include all the improvements we've been working on for the last few months and tease new features like difficulty modes and the all-new trading system. You'll be able to play all the way up to the first Winter, which is over 2 hours of gameplay!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/956162b0665b6efdef52ef9bc67e8dee722fbeee.gif

The best part? The demo has a new scoring system that shows how well you performed throughout your game. So the demo will have its own competition to see who is the best Outpost manager in the first 36 days. This competition won't be in the full release so make sure to play the demo on Steam when it releases on 13th December!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/c18d5977e73be32f7504001cf4e91ed86fe31961.png

The new scores are calculated based on days survived, total population, and deaths. This means the players topping this leaderboard will be those who can grow their population the fastest without having any of their citizens starve.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/b665b376ba6433b98d6f2ed992481137bf9ae7ae.png

Normal and Classic modes are available in the demo. In terms of difficulty these two modes are identical, but in Normal mode you can save your progress whenever you like. If your walls are breached you can rewind to a previous night and try a new strategy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/318b8015fb33eda7ddc1186f27833de485f5ca20.png

In the full game, you will be able to compete against others for overall score, number of days survived, biggest population reached, and prestige level. We will explain prestiging in a future blog post.

In the meantime, thank you so much for reading. Make sure to wishlist the game before the demo releases on 13th December!

- Sam

notes.title: What does this new building do?
notes.content:
Dear players,

Today we are talking about a new building coming to Final Outpost: Definitive Edition.

The Radio Tower
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/67b0db4f9b52022840e004688a12ef0550572e1f.gif

From base level 6, you can build the radio tower. This unlocks a new trading slot for your exchanges with the Trader, allowing you to trade more of what you want.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/a87c4000868d28ddc9ab8ce74cb110cb7c2a6b57.png

Building the radio tower unlocks an extra trading slot with the level 1 trader

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/a74d3c4957dad8699e3a4c7ce1b4346d779e8408.png

From base level 9, you can upgrade the radio tower. Long-range broadcast technology attracts a new type of trader to your Outpost. This trader sometimes sells special parts. These will become important as you grow your Outpost.

Upgrading the radio tower to level 2 attracts the level 2 trader

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/cf75fc1c293fff0bf3fc879fcd74e553bdf1029e.png

Lightning strikes are conducted by the radio tower, protecting your buildings from burning down during storms.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/513409e954150cb2f1ad00e9821add37e72efe4a.gif

Beta Signup

In advance of the demo later this year, we are running a closed beta. Anyone can join to help us test and give feedback on the game.

Save your spot in the beta: https://exabyte.kit.com/beta


Thanks for reading! Add FO:DE to your wishlist now to get notified when the demo comes out later this year.

- Sam

notes.title: Introducing the Trader
notes.content:
Dear players,

We have some exciting news on the development of Final Outpost: Definitive Edition.

The Trader
The first major addition to the game is here. Introducing the Trader!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/cf74db34d3dec0d5062cfdf7272bf909eda2f84a.gif

The Trader will regularly come to your Outpost offering up a variety of trades. Because Traders change the types of trades they offer as you build up your Outpost, you'll need to save up different resources to make sure you always have something to sell. The trader could save you next time your citizens are starving!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/978690f2ffb46822a493f3c52279b1c019d55b30.png

Electronic Scrap
In order to buy resources, you will need to sell something to obtain a new resource: electronic scrap! With electronic scrap, you can buy and sell everything from wood to machine gun bullets.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/72604190bec8d13dc279cf804c6ae2f8625fe128.png

Checkpoints
In other news, we have been working on a new checkpoint saving system. With checkpoints, you will be able to return to any point in the game to try out a new strategy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/a22f07a774df67ea47e9052db11de476179d9f14.png

New Settings Menu
And finally, we've implemented a new settings menu with video settings for PC.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/0024400b2e8eeb35a0f3f85c4d2e1d0fd5b7f97c.png

Thanks for reading! Add FO:DE to your wishlist now to get notified when the demo comes out later this year.

- Sam

notes.title: How did our page launch go?
notes.content:
Dear players,

That was a... weird? month.

First off, thank you so much for all your support around the launch of Final Outpost: Definitive Edition. In our first month on Steam, nearly 1000 of you added the game to your wishlists! That is an incredible result for our first game on Steam and this makes us even more excited to bring you the full game.

We also released a major UI overhaul as part of the 1.6 update and you all seem to really like the new look. We've had so many messages, comments and discussion on Discord so it really feels like we have a strong foundation on which to build FO:DE.

Work on patches for 1.6, holidays for the devs, and the Steam page launch basically took us to the middle of August, with gamescom fast approaching.

Although we didn't have a booth of our own this year, gamescom was such a great experience. We had the chance to meet some of our favourite developers and gaming journalists and try out upcoming games! We of course made sure to tell as many people as possible about the upcoming release of FO:DE.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/31f282249038e0f98392bbcd294c94af68c813df.jpg

All this meant that we didn't have a whole lot of time to work on Definitive Edition features but, fear not, we have been working on something very important to the game's PC playability: controller support! 

We are happy to announce that Final Outpost: Definitive Edition will have full controller support. As the game is now fully playable with keyboard and mouse, we decided to start developing a system for players to experience our RTS world from a controller while having full and responsive control of the UI. Here is a sneak-peek:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/db27dbb20e1be1b30d7fc3d7a4993ca48672bb02.gif

Building on these foundations, we are planning to have the game verified on Steam Deck.

We have also implemented a range of important PC features, such as Steam achievements, cloud save and, of course, the early stages of resolution settings:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/92060476087ea8fff7b28b07b9391d6eccda6d02.png

We are working on support for ultra-wide monitors. So far we can confirm the game will run as normal without any stretching on these monitors. However full ultra-wide support, including removal of black bars, is not yet confirmed - full details will be updated in our FAQ.

Please add FO:DE to your wishlist below. If you'd like to try the base game, you can download the free version now.

I will be back again next month with a new devlog.

- Sam

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3066310/Final_Outpost_Definitive_Edition/

notes.title: Final Outpost is coming soon on Steam!
notes.content:
That’s right, it’s a Definitive Edition. That means we’ll be taking the original popular mobile strategy game to a new level with more features, content, and replayability as we wrap up our creative journey into a complete premium game without microtransactions. The game will be available in 16 languages across 5 platforms (PC, Mac, Linux, Android and iOS).

New features we know will be in the Definitive Edition:

 Trading system
 More gameplay and replayability
 Difficulty modes
 New leaderboards and achievements
 All premium features included
 More features TBC...

Follow and wishlist the game to get news on new feature announcements in our monthly devlog!

In the meantime, Final Outpost is available on Android and iOS, with over 1M downloads since its release in 2020. The core gameplay is there so you can give that a download to see if you like the game, as a sort of early demo. If you like how it plays, you will almost certainly love Final Outpost: Definitive Edition!

The release of our Steam page coincides with the launch of Final Outpost 1.6 on mobile, an anticipated UI redesign that brings high quality polish to the base game. The update will ship with a cutscene that introduces lore to the game for the first time as well as a new menu where you can manage your Outpost's defences and control the behaviour of your turrets and snipers.

- Sam & the Final Outpost team
